title: China's first AI film hits cinemas, but public reception lukewarm

blocks.text: China’s first fully AI-generated feature film opens in cinemas on Friday, Oct. 23, in what promises to be a tough box-office test for the country’s booming tech industry as advance ticket sales lag. More than 10,000 screenings of the sci-fi thriller “Sanxingdui: Future Past” are scheduled for Friday, according to ticketing platform Maoyan. Public reception, however, has been less than enthusiastic. Presale revenue as of Friday morning stood at 80,000 yuan ($11,980), while total box-office takings were forecast to remain below 150,000 yuan, only a fraction of the reported production cost, according to Maoyan.
